fields.description: Issue features extensive editorial coverage criticizing a Dade County grand jury report on crime as politically motivated in advance of the Miami municipal election, with discussion of Commissioner H. Leslie Quigg and related campaign claims. Additional local reporting includes a radio address by Ned Palmer, Jr. on Miami’s sewage disposal plant and pollution of bay and river, commentary on airport safety and training-plane hazards, notes on Miami Transit traffic changes and accident risks, and brief items on arrests and shoplifting cases, labor rest-facilities law enforcement, and community organizations and events.
